issues.description: Behavior change: empty base_image fallback to kfp default replaced with hardcoded python:3.12
issues.detail: pipeline.py previously set self.base_image = '' on the podutils failure path with a comment saying 'Use kfp default image'. Now it forces DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE. That is a semantic change buried inside what's advertised as a UI feature. Either the comment is now a lie, or kfp's default was load-bearing and you just broke it. Split this out and justify it.

issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE duplicated in three places, guaranteed to drift
issues.detail: 'python:3.12' is now hardcoded in backend pipeline.py, the jinja template fallback (via constant), Commands.ts catch block, and CellMetadataEditor.tsx as its own exported DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE constant. The whole point of the RPC was single source of truth. Three string literals of the same value in a feature PR is bad taste. One place. Backend owns it. Frontend reads it. Period.

issues.description: THREE-PATCHES: UI replacement, semantic backend fallback change, and default-image plumbing mashed together
issues.detail: This diff does: (1) replace inline Input with a modal Button+Dialog, (2) change the empty-image fallback semantics in pipeline.py, (3) add an RPC and prop-drill defaultBaseImage through four components. Each is reviewable; together it is not. When bisect lands here in a year, which one regressed? Split it.

issues.description: Replacing a visible text input with a modal-behind-a-button is a UX regression sold as a feature
issues.detail: Users previously saw and edited the base image inline. Now they click an 'IMAGE' button, wait for a dialog, type, click Ok. More clicks, less information density, and the button is disabled until a step name exists with no explanation in the UI. The dialog adds nothing the inline input didn't already do except showing the default — which could have been a placeholder on the original Input.

issues.description: Local import of DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside the RPC function for no reason
issues.detail: get_default_base_image does 'from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE' inside the function body. There's no circular import to dodge here — the rest of the module imports from kale freely. Module-level import. This is the kind of cargo-culted defensive code that accumulates and that the next maintainer has to reason about.

issues.description: No tests for any of this
issues.detail: New RPC endpoint, changed fallback semantics in pipeline.py, new template variable, new React state plumbing — zero tests in the diff. The pipeline.py change in particular silently alters runtime behavior on an exception path. Prose in a PR description is not a regression suite. Add the test that fails without the patch and passes with it.

review.summary: REFUSE. What's pitched as a small UI feature smuggles in a backend semantic change (empty fallback string replaced with a hardcoded 'python:3.12') and a UX regression (inline input replaced by a button-and-modal). The default image string is duplicated in at least four places, defeating the entire point of the new RPC. No tests. Split this into three patches: the pipeline.py fallback change with justification and a test, the RPC and template plumbing with one canonical constant, and the dialog UI on its own merits — which I'd argue against. Local import inside the RPC is cargo culting; delete it.
